title: Prom Queen

[02:41.12]But she'd trade it all for a heart that's whole
[02:57.72]God save the prom queen
[03:05.52]God save the prom queen
[03:21.20]God save the prom queen
[03:26.37]Teenage daydream
[03:31.61]God save the prom queen (She turned her tears)
